reserveReview.rationale: OnRe's issuer-hosted Transparency Hub loads its Schedule of Assets from the cited public sheet. The 2026-08-14 sheet reports $289,757,448.67 of collateral across twelve asset rows and a separate $286,583,982.27 AUM row. The two Treasury rows were combined, while USDG (Lending) and USDC (Lending) remain Kamino protocol-position slices linked to their upstream assets. The published allocation column sums to 100.2902573392%, so the reviewed weights are normalized pro-rata to exactly 100%. OnRe separately publishes bound and offered reinsurance contracts: those are contingent underwriting obligations secured by the assets, not additional reserve assets, so adding them would double-count the balance sheet. This remains consistent with the 2026-07-15 mechanism overlay's tokenized-reinsurance classification; only the reserve composition is refreshed here.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: OnRe live Schedule of Assets dated 2026-08-14; $289,757,448.67 total collateral, $286,583,982.27 AUM, and source-native allocation percentages totaling 100.2902573392%, normalized pro-rata to 100%
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All current reserve asset categories and weights are classified. The sheet does not identify every final bank, broker, or custody-account allocation, and reinsurance claim obligations are a non-additive overlay rather than an unclassified reserve slice.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The ONyc Pool operates inside a Bermuda segregated account whose assets and liabilities are legally ring-fenced from OnRe's other books, and On Re SAC Ltd holds BMA Class IIGB insurer and Class F DABA licences (registration 55347; registry match confirmed by the 2026-07-15 Pharos registry pass), which grounds segregated custody and a structured bankruptcy-remoteness posture. Not known: the off-chain banks, brokers, or reinsurance trust accounts holding posted collateral; per-account segregation at those institutions; and the recovery waterfall if a reinsurance counterparty or cedent defaults. Posting pool capital as collateral to reinsurance counterparties is the disclosed business model, recorded as conditional rehypothecation; no lending-out of the stablecoin reserve itself is documented. Collateral deployed into roughly 5-13 month reinsurance contracts is not withdrawable on demand, and primary redemptions remain subject to redemption windows, holding periods, and liquidity availability.
